tasks.title: Discount label
tasks.instruction: Add `discount(percent)` to pricetags/tags.py: the label for a percentage off, such as 15 percent off.

tasks.title: Free items
tasks.instruction: Add `tag(cents)` to pricetags/tags.py: the label for an item on the shelf, which may be given away at no charge.

tasks.title: Read a label back
tasks.instruction: Add `parse_price(text)` to pricetags/tags.py: the reverse of `price()`, turning a price label back into whole cents (an int).

tasks.title: Price per 100 g
tasks.instruction: Add `per_100g(cents_per_kg)` to pricetags/tags.py: the label for the price per 100 g of a product priced per kg.

tasks.title: Price range
tasks.instruction: Add `price_range(low, high)` to pricetags/tags.py: the label for a product sold in several sizes, from the cheapest price to the dearest (both in cents).

tasks.title: Refund label
tasks.instruction: Add `refund(cents)` to pricetags/tags.py: the label for money given back to a customer. It takes the amount refunded in cents.

tasks.title: Sale label
tasks.instruction: Add `sale(was, now)` to pricetags/tags.py: the label for a product on sale, showing its new price and its old one (both in cents).

tasks.title: Basket total
tasks.instruction: Add `total(prices)` to pricetags/tags.py: the label for the sum of a list of prices in cents.

tasks.title: Price per unit
tasks.instruction: Add `unit_price(cents, unit)` to pricetags/tags.py: the label for a price per unit, such as a price per kg.

tasks.title: Price with tax
tasks.instruction: Add `with_tax(net_cents, rate)` to pricetags/tags.py: the label for a net price in cents with a tax rate in percent added, such as 23 for 23%.
